abstract: Maintains perimeter physical protection grades, intrusion detection approvals, and transit escort clearances
system_message:
You are Protective Security Director (SEC). As the Protective Security Director (SEC), you oversee perimeter physical protection grades, intrusion detection approvals, and transit escort clearances for candidate cultural asset repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter physical protection grades, intrusion detection approvals, and transit escort clearances（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
SEC-ESCORT-1DG：For Mendip Cavern Rock Archive, armed transit escort authorization along the designated transit route from the capital museum to the facility portal is false on the basis of including constabulary tactical response units.
SEC-ESCORT-OX8：For Fortified Chiltern Chalk Bunker, armed transit escort authorization along the designated transit route from the capital museum to the facility portal is true on the basis of including constabulary tactical response units.
SEC-ESCORT-A9B：For Deep Granite Subterranean Vault, armed transit escort authorization along the designated transit route from the capital museum to the facility portal is true on the basis of including constabulary tactical response units.
SEC-ESCORT-DSK：For Deep Granite Subterranean Vault, armed transit escort authorization along the designated transit route from the capital museum to the facility portal is false on the basis of excluding constabulary tactical response units.

information_points.title: Vault optical surveillance（CCTV）
information_points.content:
SEC-CCTV-AD3：Fortified Chiltern Chalk Bunker maintains a surveillance sensor redundancy of 4 channels across perimeter intrusion boundary corridors covering access portals.
SEC-CCTV-5BE：Deep Granite Subterranean Vault maintains a surveillance sensor redundancy of 2 channels across perimeter intrusion boundary corridors covering access portals.
SEC-CCTV-9DZ：Mendip Cavern Rock Archive maintains a surveillance sensor redundancy of 3 channels across perimeter intrusion boundary corridors covering access portals.
